annotations.title: Get property rules for a place

description: Property rules in force for a place in Spain, resolved up the chain municipality → comunidad → state: rates, scales, reductions, deadlines, rental and tourist-rental regimes, with official source, check date and tier per figure. Filter by topic: purchase (Buying: transfer tax (ITP), stamp duty (AJD), VAT / IGIC on new builds, notary and registry fees, cost sharing); annual (Owning every year: IBI property tax, empty-home surcharges, waste tax, imputed income (IRPF / IRNR), non-resident Modelo 210); rental (Long-term renting: LAU, rent caps and updates, stressed areas, rental income tax reductions, room rentals); tourist_rental (Tourist / short-term rental: regional regime, municipal licences, the national registry, VAT, IBI tourist surcharge); sale (Selling: municipal plusvalía, capital gains (IRPF), non-resident 3% retention, reinvestment and over-65 exemptions); inheritance_gift (Inheritance and gifts: ISD scales, reductions and bonuses by comunidad, deadlines, plusvalía mortis causa); other (Everything else: mortgages (LCCI), squatting, VPO, co-ownership dissolution, renovation, company tax). En español: normativa e impuestos de una vivienda en un municipio: ITP, AJD, IVA, gastos de notaría y registro, IBI, recargo por vivienda vacía, plusvalía municipal, IRPF, IRNR y modelo 210 de no residentes, impuesto de sucesiones y donaciones, alquiler (LAU, zona tensionada, actualización de la renta), alquiler turístico (VUT, licencias), herencias.

date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD: the rules in force on that date. Default today.

place_id.description: A place id returned by find_place.

topic.description: Topic. Without it you get an index of every rule (key, label, headline value); pass a topic for the full rows.
